title: metrics_batch (agent -> hub)
description: One scrape cycle of samples. Fire-and-forget: the hub never acks and the agent never retries (a lost batch is a 2 s gap). Each sample carries its own ts. The hub inserts rows into metric_samples_gpu / metric_samples_engine / metric_samples_session adding node_id from the envelope. Batches larger than 1 MiB are split by the agent.

sequence.description: Per-connection increasing counter; the hub logs gaps for diagnostics only.

agent.description: Agent self-metrics (exported on the agent's Prometheus endpoint too).
